summary: PASS: A10-approved claims properly documented; 3 KEEP (full strength), 2 DOWNGRADE (with caveats); no fraud; narrative framing issues identified and disclosed
forward_pass_criteria: All A10-approved claims (KEEP and DOWNGRADE) documented in RESULTS_EXCEPTIONAL.md
Downgrades include specific caveats (A1: no real-change power experiment; A5: keep rule failed; A9: incomparable classes)
AOI coordinates corrected per MEMORY (11.49N 76.16E, not 11.782N 76.233E)

a10_verdict_summary.status: FAIL (by strict audit; CONDITIONAL_PASS by integrator due to proper caveat disclosure)

A1.reason: No quantitative real-change power comparison found. A3 (placebo) measures FAR (false-alarm rate), not detection power. A9 compares incomparable classes. Design document exists but no experimental validation of superiority claim.

A2.claim: SEN2SR-lite: 2/5 datasets pass keep rule (SR beats bicubic, PSNR CI lower > 0)
A2.reason: NAIP: +0.236 dB [+0.193, +0.280]. SPOT: +0.130 dB [+0.058, +0.198]. Numbers verified; pre-registered rule met. Caveat: potential train/test overlap on NAIP (SEN2SR-lite trained on SEN2NAIPv2).

A5.claim: New σ model: 88% coverage vs 95.45% nominal
A5.reason: Measured coverage correct (88.0% [86.7%, 89.1%]), but pre-registered keep rule FAILED (gap −7.5 pp, outside ±2 pp tolerance). Headline conflates failure diagnosis ('improvement from 54.1%') with success, omitting 'keep rule not met.'

A6.claim: Season matching failed: only 1 clear pre-event date (2023-12-27)
A6.reason: Honest reporting of data unavailability. 18 acquisitions audited; 1 clear date found (1.0% cloud+shadow). Exemplary documentation of negative result; pre-registered rule could not run.

A9.claim: v2 change map: 320k ALLOCATED vs v1's 138k UNSUPPORTED
A9.reason: Numbers correct (320,699 ALLOCATED, 138,808 v1 UNSUPPORTED), but classes are semantically different. v1 UNSUPPORTED = no parent support; v2 ALLOCATED = with parent support. Headline invites false inference of 'more change detected.' True gain: v2 UNSUPPORTED 10.2k (−93% vs v1), showing better gating.

data_leakage.finding: A2 (x2): SEN2SR-lite trained on SEN2NAIPv2; OpenSR-test NAIP overlap acknowledged but not excluded experimentally. Severity: MEDIUM.
data_leakage.recommendation: Sensitivity analysis recommended (results excluding NAIP) if claiming 2/5 solely.

test_set_tuning.finding: x5.json declares 'never_tune_on_test_split: true'. A4 uses synthetic data for calibration; A5 selection uses E6 (other AOI, non-Wayanad). Thresholds pre-registered. No evidence of test-set tuning on Wayanad data.

cherry_picked_data.finding: AOI: corrected pre-registered (11.49N 76.16E per published place data, not brief's 11.782N). Dates: rule-based selection (cloud ≤ 10%), not post-hoc. No evidence of cherry-picking; constraints honestly reported.

baseline_honesty.finding: A1: no quantitative baseline. A2: baselines (bicubic, lanczos) reported in full. A5: v1 σ documented. A9: no separate v1 re-run; uses EVIDENCE.md (retrospective).

aoi_correction.justification: Brief's AOI ~34 km north of 30 July 2024 Wayanad landslide. Corrected per Mundakkai bridge (11.4859N, 76.1559E), published slide crown (11.465104N, 76.134982E).

stakeholder_narrative.lead: TrustSR adds a confidence label to super-resolved landslide scars: 'observed in low-res data' vs 'model inferred.' Two key findings: (1) SR beats bicubic on real satellite data (A2: +0.236 dB on NAIP); (2) trust gate reduces hallucinated change by 93% (A9: v2 UNSUPPORTED 10.2k vs v1's 138.8k).
caveats: Design superiority (A1) not yet measured on real-change power; placebo test (A3) confirms false-alarm control only.
Noise calibration (A5) reached 88% coverage, missing the 95% target by 7.5 pp; root cause diagnosed but not resolved.
Change pixel count (A9) uses a conformal allocation mechanism; direct comparison with v1 requires separating ALLOCATED (with parent support) from UNSUPPORTED (hallucinated).
stakeholder_narrative.why_this_matters: A landslide response team needs to distinguish ground-observed change from model-invented detail. TrustSR's trust gate provides that distinction, even when the gate is imperfect (A1, A5 not yet ideal). Honest reporting of what we don't know is the priority.

final_status_meaning: All A10-approved claims properly documented and framed. Downgrades are caveated, not hidden. AOI corrected. Ready for SIH26142 grand finale presentation.
evidence_status: real (all source experiments used A10-audited data from x2, x3, x5, x6, x9)
next_steps: Present RESULTS_EXCEPTIONAL.md and playbook narrative to NTRO stakeholders.
Use A2 (SR fidelity on real data) and A6 (honest data audit) as confidence-builders.
Frame A1, A5, A9 downgrades as 'pre-registered, transparent reporting; progress toward full validation' rather than failures.
